queries.result: First-party discovery found FreiGIS, the City of Freiburg geoportal, and the City’s Liegenschaftskataster and Geoinformation pages. FreiGIS documents parcel search and public city geodata access.

queries.result: First-party discovery found the official FreiGIS portal and the Freiburg municipal Liegenschaftskataster page, which identifies the city cadastral register as the complete record for the city area and links parcel-map procedures.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Stadt Freiburg im Breisgau, Stabsstelle Digitales Bauen und GeoIT / FreiGIS; the official portal configuration identifies the city as provider and exposes the parcel search and WFS.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalOrStateContext: The city portal uses official cadastral base data; no separate state service was needed for this bounded qualification.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The official municipal FreiGIS portal is live, its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected, and its parcel WFS returned a bounded anonymous feature at the preserved point.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A local municipal cadastral map/service is evidenced and operationally queried; this is not a claim of citywide adapter admission.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N), declared in the GeoJSON CRS object; retained without reprojection.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; the stable native flstkz field returned by the ms:flst WFS was used directly.
schemaAndCrs.schemaEvidence: DescribeFeatureType for ms:flst listed the_geom, gid, gmkflur, flstnr, buchflaech, flstkz, zeigtauf, istgebucht, rechtswert, hochwert, gmlid, and lz_beginnt. Only flstkz and geometry were retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The WUP point was transformed only for the EPSG:25832 spatial test; the returned polygon contains the exact preserved WUP coordinate [48.0006635061131, 7.83778338402154] after the corresponding coordinate transformation.
